description: Operator view of how the Celestia network is doing right now, from Unity Nodes Pulse: latest block and the measured block time, throughput, staking, the validator set (active, inactive, jailed, online voting power), how full recent blocks are and which validators produced them, which rollups posted the most data, the DA light-node measurements Unity Nodes takes (network and local head, sampling lag, header arrival lag) and the official status page. Mainnet or the Mocha testnet (block fullness, rollups and the status page are mainnet only). Celestia only, a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes. For live on-chain totals and the TIA price use get_network_state.
name: get_celestia_network_health
